title: Find and fix the STATUS_HEAP_CORRUPTION crash of the engram library test binary on Windows B
outcome: Find and fix the STATUS_HEAP_CORRUPTION crash of the engram library test binary on Windows B
acceptance: The crashing test (or tests) is identified by a bounded diagnostic run, and the root cause of the 0xc0000374 heap corruption is recorded with evidence
The defect is fixed in code (not by skipping, ignoring or loosening a test), and the ordinary Rust test stage passes on Windows B with the default runner settings on the fixed commit
If the cause is in a dependency or the platform, the item records the evidence and the concrete fix or upgrade taken
